subject: MSA & Order Form — party sheet and initial redline queue
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Dana Li <dana.li@vectoredge.io>, contracts@vectoredge.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VectorEdge - MSA + Order Form submission

Hi Dana / VectorEdge contracts team —

Thanks for sending over the MSA and the order form draft this morning (attached: VectorEdge_MSA_v1.docx, OrderForm_Draft.xlsx). We’re excited to move forward. Quick summary and asks so Legal/RevOps can triage: 

- Timeline: customer wants signed MSA + Order Form by end of next week (Wed 2026-07-21).
- Priority items we need Legal to review first-pass: indemnity and limitation of liability, termination for convenience, data deletion/franchise windows, audit rights, and any unusual export/data residency language.
- Security: VectorEdge noted they’re SOC2-compliant and will share the attestation — please confirm what evidence format we need.
- Billing: verify payment terms in order form (they proposed Net30) and confirm Exhibit B billing contact (Raj Patel, raj@vectoredge.io).
- Commercial: customer expects ~ $150k ARR first-year committed spend; flag any clauses that would block routing to Dedicated capacity if we need to reserve GPUs.

Party details they provided (please use to populate Exhibit A):
- Legal name: VectorEdge Inc.
- Address: 610 Harbor Blvd, Suite 400, Oakland, CA 94607
- Primary technical contact: Dana Li, dana.li@vectoredge.io, +1 415-555-0123
- Billing contact: Raj Patel, raj@vectoredge.io

Action requested: Can Legal do a redline (track changes) on the MSA and call out top-5 commercial/legal risks by EOD Monday (2026-07-13)? RevOps (Laura) — can you prep an Exhibit B draft with billing contact and payment schedule? I’ll coordinate a 30-min sync with the customer for Thu 2026-07-15.

Thanks — Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com | +1 916-555-0187
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Li <dana.li@vectoredge.io>, contracts@vectoredge.io
Date: 2026-07-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VectorEdge - MSA + Order Form submission

Priya — thanks for the clear ask and party sheet. I’ll take first pass on the MSA and flag the top-level risk items. Initial notes from Legal intake: 

- Indemnity / liability: MSA currently has mutual indemnities but with a customer-favorable cap tied to aggregate fees; recommend we propose a cap equal to 12 months of fees and carve out IP indemnity.
- Termination: propose tightening termination for convenience notice to 60 days and add transition assistance obligations in SOW/exhibit.
- Data deletion: customer requested a 90-day deletion window — need to check with Product whether 90 days is acceptable; default is 30 days in our standard.
- Audit rights: request to clarify scope and frequency of audits; will ask for SOC2 report first and then determine whether spot audits are needed.
- Export/compliance: flagged an EU data residency sentence in the introduction — needs clarity on whether it is a representation or a plan.

I don’t have the SOC2 yet so I’ll treat security as conditional. I can deliver a marked-up MSA with commentary by 2026-07-13 17:00 PT. Karthik — can you lead on indemnity language? Laura — can you draft the Exhibit B and billing schedule and confirm whether RevOps needs a PO or a contract-first approach for Net30?

Also attaching my suggested review checklist (markup not attached here) and a proposed timeline for counterparty redlines.

-Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Dana Li <dana.li@vectoredge.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@vectoredge.io, Raj Patel <raj@vectoredge.io>
Date: 2026-07-13T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VectorEdge - MSA + Order Form submission

Hi Priya / Marissa / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC2: attached SOC2_Report_2025.pdf; happy to provide our auditor contact or a SOC2 bridge letter if needed.
- Payment terms: VectorEdge can accept Net30 for the first year; beyond that we may want to discuss annual renewal payment cadence.
- Committed spend: the $150k ARR is our internal planning number; we can make this explicit in the Order Form but it’s not a minimum financial obligation in year 1 — we’d like the flexibility to scale.
- Data deletion: customer prefers 90-day deletion after termination; willing to discuss 60 days if Redwood requires that for operational reasons.
- Indemnity: we indicated mutual indemnities with a carve for IP infringement. If Redwood has standard language, please share your suggested redlines.

We’re available for the Thu 2026-07-15 10:00 PT sync Priya proposed.

Thanks,
Dana

Attachments: SOC2_Report_2025.pdf

Dana Li
Head of IT Security | VectorEdge Inc.
dana.li@vectoredge.io | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: VectorEdge - MSA + Order Form submission

All — thanks for the fast responses and for the SOC2 upload, Dana. Next steps and owners: 

- Marissa: please send the redline back to me and cc: customer by EOD 2026-07-15; focus commentary on indemnity cap, termination notice, and data deletion window.
- Karthik: lead on drafting the indemnity language (target: propose cap = 12 months fees, IP carveouts, mutual defense scope). Please include fallback language if customer insists on lower cap.
- Laura: draft Exhibit B (billing schedule, PO flow for Net30) and confirm RevOps needs; add Raj Patel as billing contact.
- Priya (me): I’ll run the Thu 10:00 PT sync and capture any commercial concessions; I’ll also add CON-827 in Jira for legal tracking and upload the redline to the HubSpot deal HS-1009234.

If anyone anticipates a longer review, flag now — customer wants a clean execution by 2026-07-21.

Thanks team — Priya
